quotes.name: Austin Reaves
quotes.quote: Look, 2-0 feels good, don't get me wrong. But I've been around long enough to know a record doesn't hold the building up. It's the guys inside it. We're still figuring out who we are out there — roles, rotations, all that. The structure shifting? That's just part of the game. You don't carry the weight by pretending everything's locked in. You carry it by showing up, doing your job, and trusting the guys next to you. That's what I'm doing. That's all I can do.
